config.expected_if_true: In all 3 seeds: final best-of-5 accel_step control R2 <= 0.45; final accel_step margin >= 0.2; persistent 0.1-bar formation step in [60, 200]; and |0.1-bar step - half-final-margin step| <= 30. accel_step's headroom-normalized margin exceeds force's at the final checkpoint.
config.hypothesis: Matched-seed N=64 reference arm at high eccentricity. At e in [0, 0.85] the accel_step random control is low, so the margin is not capped by the control. A 4-layer d_model=64 model at N=64 then forms accel_step persistently (first checkpoint after which the margin stays >= required_margin at every later checkpoint, read from the trajectory) within steps 60-200. Its final margin is well above the 0.12-0.17 seen at e <= 0.5, so the 0.1 bar and the half-final-margin measure give formation steps within 30 steps of each other in every seed.
